section_summary: This section chiefly records Japanese merchant and naval vessel movements in March 1941. Incoming consular telegrams are frequently followed by paraphrases sent to the Navy Department. Other documents address possible fuel supplies to commerce raiders, monitoring Japanese ships in the Philippines, German passengers aboard the Rakuyo Maru, and British concerns about the Asaka Maru.

subfiles.title: Liaison note on fueling policy
subfiles.about: Considers whether a proposed policy for Japanese vessels should await decisions on German and Italian ships.
subfiles.summary: Wilson favors the proposed telegram's policy, subject to Far Eastern Affairs and Welles's review.

subfiles.title: Handwritten note deferring action
subfiles.about: Records a decision to defer action pending a departmental policy on fueling German and Italian ships.
subfiles.summary: Action deferred until the fueling policy is settled.

subfiles.title: Liaison note to Welles
subfiles.about: Suggests discussing a Japanese vessel telegram alongside the issue of German ships in Brazil.
subfiles.summary: Wilson proposes discussion at the Liaison Meeting before answering the telegram.

subfiles.title: Singapore telegram on limiting Japanese vessels' supplies
subfiles.about: Reports British and Dutch plans to restrict oil, coal, and water supplied to Japanese vessels.
subfiles.summary: Patton asks whether Philippine ports will adopt a similar policy to prevent supplies reaching enemy raiders.

subfiles.title: Philippine Affairs assessment of bunker fuel sales
subfiles.about: Assesses the risk of Japanese vessels supplying commerce raiders from Philippine ports.
subfiles.summary: The memorandum finds no basis for treating all Japanese ships as suspect or routinely restricting their fuel. It recommends monitoring unusual sales and asking the High Commissioner whether suppliers would voluntarily limit supplies to the next port.

subfiles.title: Cover note for approved telegram
subfiles.about: Submits the previously approved substance of a telegram for initials.
subfiles.summary: Requests initials on the telegram.

subfiles.title: Draft telegram to Philippine High Commissioner
subfiles.about: Requests reports of Japanese bunker fuel purchases and views on voluntary supply limits.
subfiles.summary: The draft asks for scrutiny of abnormal sales and advice on limiting supplies to the next port.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Philippine High Commissioner
subfiles.about: Directs the High Commissioner to monitor Japanese bunker fuel purchases and assess voluntary supply limits.
subfiles.summary: Requests reports of suspicious sales and comments on limits proposed in Singapore and the Netherlands Indies.

subfiles.title: Havana Maru movement report
subfiles.about: Reports the Havana Maru's arrival from Hong Kong and departure for Bombay via Penang.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 17 and sailed March 19.

subfiles.title: Havana Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Havana Maru's Singapore movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's arrival and sailing report.

subfiles.title: Yokohama vessel departures
subfiles.about: Reports departures of the Awazisan, Toho, and Borneo Maru.
subfiles.summary: Destinations include Manila, Cebu, Los Angeles, and Calcutta.

subfiles.title: Yokohama departures to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays March 17 Yokohama departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the Awazisan, Toho, and Borneo Maru report.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports the Buenos Aires Maru's arrival, departure, and route toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship departed March 18 via South American ports, the Panama Canal, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires Maru's Montevideo movement and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Chapin's March 19 report.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings of March 16–17
subfiles.about: Reports sailings of several Japanese ships to North America, the Philippines, and Batavia.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Yawata, tankers, Hie, and reported Samarang movement.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Yokohama sailing routes reported by Linnell.
subfiles.summary: Lists the Hie, Yawata, Kano, and Samarang; the original also mentions a tanker.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health issued to five Japanese merchant ships.
subfiles.summary: Lists intended routes to North America, the Philippines, and the Panama Canal Zone.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Kobe bills of health and intended routes.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Sokobin's report on five ships.

subfiles.title: Handwritten file note
subfiles.about: Contains a largely illegible handwritten remark concerning passengers.
subfiles.summary: The note's full instruction is unreadable in the OCR.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru takes aboard German passengers
subfiles.about: Reports that the Rakuyo Maru embarked 18 Germans off Buenaventura Bay.
subfiles.summary: The ship then departed for Acapulco, Manzanillo, Los Angeles, and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Rakuyo Maru's embarkation of 18 Germans and onward route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Williams's report from Cali.

subfiles.title: Telegram to Mexico on Rakuyo Maru passengers
subfiles.about: Requests tracking of the Rakuyo Maru's 18 German passengers at Mexican ports.
subfiles.summary: Directs repetition to Acapulco and Manzanillo and permits notice to appropriate Mexican authorities.

subfiles.title: Nan Maru and Haruna Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports arrivals and departures of the Nan Maru and Haruna Maru.
subfiles.summary: Gives routes toward South Africa, South America, and Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel movements to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Nan Maru and Haruna Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's Singapore report.

subfiles.title: Nanman Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Nanman Maru's arrival and departure toward Los Angeles and Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 12 and departed March 21.

subfiles.title: Nanman Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Nanman Maru's Buenos Aires movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Armour's report.

subfiles.title: Bombay departures for Japan
subfiles.about: Reports the Lisbon Maru and Syunko Maru sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: Both ships departed March 21 by routes through Southeast Asia.

subfiles.title: Bombay departures to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Lisbon Maru and Syunko Maru sailings.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Donovan's Bombay report.

subfiles.title: Sanuku Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the Sanuku Maru's cargo exchange and departure for Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: The ship discharged Japanese goods and loaded resin and medicines.

subfiles.title: Sanuku Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Sanuku Maru's Manzanillo cargo and departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Hoyt's report.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings of March 19
subfiles.about: Reports routes of the Arimason, Kinai, Sakito, and San Luis Maru.
subfiles.summary: Destinations include New York, South America, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: March 19 sailings to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays four Yokohama sailings and their routes.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's March 20 telegram.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports the Akagi Maru's arrival from Arica and departure for Valparaíso.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 21 and sailed March 22.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Akagi Maru's Antofagasta movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Adams's report.

subfiles.title: Hokkai Maru and Havre Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports routes of the Hokkai Maru and Havre Maru.
subfiles.summary: The Hokkai Maru heads toward New York; the Havre Maru sails for Keelung.

subfiles.title: Singapore vessel report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Hokkai Maru and Havre Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's Singapore telegram.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports the Kimikawa Maru's arrival from the Canal Zone and departure for Callao.
subfiles.summary: The ship called at Guayaquil on March 22.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kimikawa Maru's Guayaquil call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Thiel's report.

subfiles.title: Offer of Malayan iron ore shipping reports
subfiles.about: Offers to report sailings of Japanese vessels carrying iron ore from eastern Malaya.
subfiles.summary: Patton asks whether the Department wants the information.

subfiles.title: Paraphrase of iron ore shipping offer
subfiles.about: Relays Patton's offer to report Japanese iron ore ship departures.
subfiles.summary: Asks whether the information is desired.

subfiles.title: Liaison inquiry to Navy on iron ore reports
subfiles.about: Asks whether the Navy wants Singapore reports on Japanese iron ore vessels.
subfiles.summary: Encloses Patton's paraphrased telegram and requests a decision.

subfiles.title: Instruction to Singapore on iron ore reports
subfiles.about: Informs Singapore that the Navy wants Japanese iron ore vessel reports.
subfiles.summary: Directs charging telegram costs to the Navy Department.

subfiles.title: Kamogawa Maru loading at Barahona
subfiles.about: Reports an instruction to hasten the Kamogawa Maru's rock salt loading and departure for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The local agent expects the vessel to sail the following Wednesday.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru at Buenaventura
subfiles.about: Reports the Heiyo Maru's call at Buenaventura on March 22.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Balboa and departed for Guayaquil the same day.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru movement paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Heiyo Maru's Buenaventura call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Williams's report.

subfiles.title: Nanman Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports the Nanman Maru's arrival and intended route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: The route includes Brazilian ports, the Panama Canal, and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Nanman Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Nanman Maru's Montevideo movement and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Chapin's telegram.

subfiles.title: Three Japanese ships at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports movements of the Nansin, Onoe, and Melbourne Maru.
subfiles.summary: Gives arrivals and routes toward Japan, Karachi, and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Singapore movements to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Nansin, Onoe, and Melbourne Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's report.

subfiles.title: Japanese freighters loading lead at Tampico
subfiles.about: Reports two unusually large Japanese freighters expected to load about 10,000 tons of lead.
subfiles.summary: Both arrived in ballast and reportedly intend to sail to Japan via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Tampico lead cargo report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Collins's report on Japanese freighters and a large lead cargo.
subfiles.summary: Identifies the ships as Nasosan Maru and Taketoyo Maru.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Buenos Aires Maru's arrival and planned departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 19 and was due to sail March 25.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires Maru's Buenos Aires call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Armour's report.

subfiles.title: Yokohama sailings of March 20–21
subfiles.about: Reports Japanese passenger, merchant, and tanker sailings.
subfiles.summary: Destinations span the United States, Philippines, India, Indonesia, and Basra.

subfiles.title: March 20–21 sailings to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays Linnell's March 20–21 vessel departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases reported routes of eight vessels.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health of March 17–22
subfiles.about: Reports bills of health for five Japanese merchant vessels.
subfiles.summary: Lists intended routes to the United States and Manila.

subfiles.title: Kobe bills of health to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the five Kobe bills of health and ship routes.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Sokobin's telegram.

subfiles.title: Nitiei Maru sails to load petroleum
subfiles.about: Reports the Nitiei Maru's departure from Aioi for San Francisco to load oil and gasoline.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese merchant vessel sails directly to San Francisco.

subfiles.title: Nitiei Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Nitiei Maru's petroleum loading voyage.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Sokobin's Aioi departure report.

subfiles.title: Naval tanker Erimo bound for Los Angeles
subfiles.about: Reports the Japanese naval tanker Erimo's planned departure to load oil and gasoline.
subfiles.summary: The tanker is due to leave Kure on March 27 for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Erimo report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Erimo's planned petroleum loading voyage.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Sokobin's report.

subfiles.title: Conversation with Halifax concerning Asaka Maru
subfiles.about: Records British concerns that the Asaka Maru would carry German war material from Lisbon to Japan.
subfiles.summary: Halifax sought urgent U.S. views on a British proposal to warn Japan that the vessel could be intercepted and contraband removed under the blockade of Germany. Welles promised a reply within 24 hours.

subfiles.title: Husimi Maru bill of health
subfiles.about: Reports the Husimi Maru's bill of health and route from Melbourne toward Japan.
subfiles.summary: The route includes Australian ports, the Philippines, and Hong Kong.

subfiles.title: Husimi Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Husimi Maru's Melbourne departure and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Dickover's telegram.

subfiles.title: Asosan Maru lead cargo and departure
subfiles.about: Reports a Japanese ship loading 2,000 tons of bar lead and preparing to leave Tampico.
subfiles.summary: The vessel is bound via New Orleans and the Panama Canal for Japan.

subfiles.title: Asosan Maru departure to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Asosan Maru's expected departure from Tampico.
subfiles.summary: Gives New Orleans and the Panama Canal as subsequent route points.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Akagi Maru's arrival and departure for Hong Kong via Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 24 from Antofagasta and sailed March 27.

subfiles.title: Akagi Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Akagi Maru's Valparaíso movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Burt's report.

subfiles.title: Kimikawa Maru at Lima-area ports
subfiles.about: Reports the Kimikawa Maru's arrival from Guayaquil and departure for Mala.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 25 and sailed March 26.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru at Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamabiko Maru's Santos call.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived from Kobe March 24 and sailed for Buenos Aires March 25.

subfiles.title: Yamabiko Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamabiko Maru's Santos movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Foster's report.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru at Rio Grande
subfiles.about: Reports the Buenos Aires Maru's Rio Grande call and route toward Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The ship cleared March 27 via Brazilian ports and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Buenos Aires Maru report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Buenos Aires Maru's Rio Grande movement.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Braddock's report; it calls the vessel a warship, unlike the original.

subfiles.title: Kyokuto and Nissho sailings
subfiles.about: Reports the naval tanker Kyokuto sailing to San Francisco and Nissho reportedly sailing to Indonesia.
subfiles.summary: Both departures are dated March 24.

subfiles.title: Kyokuto and Nissho report to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kyokuto and Nissho departures.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report.

subfiles.title: Koei, Matumoto, and Tokio Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports March 25 sailings toward Oakland, Calcutta, and Melbourne.
subfiles.summary: The Matumoto and Tokio Maru sailings are reported rather than directly confirmed.

subfiles.title: March 25 Yokohama sailings to Navy
subfiles.about: Relays the Koei, Matumoto, and Tokio Maru sailings.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linnell's report.

subfiles.title: Heiyo Maru sails for Mollendo
subfiles.about: Reports the Heiyo Maru's arrival from Salinas and departure for Mollendo.
subfiles.summary: The ship arrived March 26 and sailed March 27.
